fonts.note: EB Garamond everywhere Lato/Inter serve in lectures. Math = MathTex (Computer Modern). Standalone numerals outside MathTex = JetBrains Mono. Drop the TTFs in each video's fonts/.

dark.note: Default. Near-black canvas, parchment ink. Blue = the object under study; brown = its foil; yellow = transient emphasis, one at a time.

light.note: White-canvas alternate. Blue doubles as emphasis (yellow fails on white). Never pure black text.

note: Brown Blue — 3b1b-template pure-Manim explainers for Bear's Notes. Voice is the Bear Brown clone (set per beat_sheet). forbidden_color is the lecture red — it must never appear in a brownblue frame. Key via ELEVENLABS_API_KEY env var — NEVER commit.
